# Recount

> Funds say they lead. See if they did. Recount counts, from Cala funding-round data, whether a VC fund actually leads rounds at a founder's stage and size or mostly follows, when it last led, whether it led a competitor's round, and which of the founder's investors has sat in a small round with it (an intro path). Every number opens the Cala record and source documents behind it. Built at Junction 2026 for Cala's "Make Unicorns Real" challenge. Counting, not AI.

Key facts:
- Data: 5,200 rounds, 3,393 companies, 195 funds asked investor-first, 4,406 Cala entity IDs. Cala is the only data source.
- Cala layers used: POST /v1/knowledge/query (investor-first and company-first), POST /v1/knowledge/search (source documents), /v1/entities (FundingRound entities with is_lead, as a cross-check).
- Validation: stronger earlier lead record picks the real lead 50% vs 36% random in 1,598 rounds (95% CI 47 to 52%); hand check against press 22 of 26 correct; entity graph agrees 6 of 6 where it marks a lead.
- Prediction tested honestly on 558 held-out rounds with 8 methods and a leakage audit: a current investor leads about 1 in 4 next rounds and the previous round's lead itself about 1 in 6 (17%); a new outside lead is only 4 to 5% in the top 5, so the product shows evidence, not odds.
- Stack: Cala, Aiven for PostgreSQL (system of record and spending caps), Modal (FastAPI app and background live lookups), Gemini only for parsing messy pasted lines.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/README.md): need, what it does, judging criteria map, architecture, how to run
- [Evidence](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/docs/EVIDENCE.md): every claimed number with its source file and method
- [Live demo](https://robin-81988--recount.us-east.modal.run): no login; add #demo to run the sample list

## Code
- [app/engine.py](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/app/engine.py): verdicts, lead ratios, size fit, conflicts, intro paths (ties), discovery
- [app/merge.py](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/app/merge.py): merging investor-first and company-first Cala rows into rounds
- [app/graph.py](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/app/graph.py): cross-check against Cala's entity graph
- [app/live.py](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/app/live.py): live Cala lookups with per-session and per-day caps
- [app/main.py](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/app/main.py): FastAPI API and security headers
- [pipeline/](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/pipeline/): crawl, normalise, build snapshot, validate

## Research
- [research/prediction/RESULTS.md](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/research/prediction/RESULTS.md): can the next lead be predicted (8 methods, leakage audit)
- [research/accuracy/accuracy.md](https://github.com/RobinWick/relay-junction/blob/main/research/accuracy/accuracy.md): hand check against press releases
